unsupported_features.reason: BBS selective-disclosure proof suites live outside identity envelope primitives and must be injected through the zk/disclosure-policy boundary when supported.
This crate currently implements the did:me es256-jws-cid-2025 suite only; generic EdDSA Data Integrity suites are not exposed as identity-owned envelope APIs.
The supported did:me suite binds canonical DAG-CBOR current-core CIDs; RDF dataset canonicalization suites are intentionally not implemented in this crate.
Concrete circuit selection, proving, and verification live in reallyme/zk and are composed with SSI credential contracts by reallyme/openid4vp. SSI has no compile-time dependency on ZK crates.
OpenID4VCI and OpenID4VP request/response state machines, HTTP handlers, nonce stores, and endpoint orchestration live in protocol repositories.
Typed product operation transport, dispatch, and provider execution moved to reallyme/identity. SSI retains only protocol-neutral messages and bounded domain codecs.
Replay-safe provider executor sequencing and operation binding moved to reallyme/identity with the product operation runtime.
ISO 18013-7 Annex B, OpenID4VP handover, and Digital Credentials API transport live in protocol repositories.
